source_clause: R1HVS2.) For Single-Level heated steering wheel, a press of the heated steering wheel button opens popup and turns the wheel heat to ON . The next press turns the heated wheel OFF , the button is no longer highlighted.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.9（R1HVS2）以兩句定出 Single-Level 加熱方向盤之開關兩態，兩個 037 leaf 對應之。關鍵情境條件：起始 PC 取第七軸之 Single-Level 值；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：兩態各自成條，其失效（開不了／關不掉）互相獨立。刻意略過：**`063-01` 之 popup 內容不驗**（DR #11）；本節與 `11.8` 為同一功能在第七軸兩值上之陳述，故非重複而為軸值之別（見 `distinguishing_axis`）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第七軸「加熱方向盤 Multi / Single」之值（功能型）

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort section 之加熱方向盤軟鍵（單段）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: A press of the single-level wheel button opens the popup and turns it on
tcs.test_item: The system shall on a press of the heated steering wheel button open the popup and turn the wheel heat to ON
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a Single-Level heated steering wheel (11.9)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the heated steering wheel button in the comfort section
2. Read the heated steering wheel button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The heated steering wheel popup opens
2. The wheel heat is on and the button is highlighted

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.tc_title: The next press turns the single-level heated wheel off
tcs.test_item: The system shall on the next press turn the heated wheel OFF, the button no longer highlighted
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a Single-Level heated steering wheel (11.9)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the heated steering wheel on
2. Press the heated steering wheel button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The wheel heat is on
2. The wheel heat is off and the button is no longer highlighted
